module: Flowgraph node "Select Buttons" (category once_instant, once + singleActive): choice dialogue with several buttons (ui_missionInfo.openDialogue). Inputs: "title", "description" (string or multiTranslationObject), "altMode" (dialogue at the bottom of the screen, hidden), "hideApps" (hides the apps, hidden), and for each option (default accept / decline) a string input pin (label; empty = ignored) and a flow output pin set to true on click.
notes: Showing two of these at the same time will break everything (todo from the code).
If the input flow drops to false while the dialogue is open, it is closed.

_afterTrigger.desc: Closes the dialogue if the input flow is false.

_executionStopped.desc: Closes the dialogue if it is open.

buttonPushed.desc: Sets the output of the clicked button to true (the others to false) and closes the dialogue.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

closeDialogue.desc: Closes the dialogue (ui_missionInfo) and shows the apps again if hidden.

getCmd.desc: Returns the Lua command that calls buttonPushed(action) back.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

onNodeReset.desc: Closes the dialogue and resets the outputs to false.

openDialogue.desc: Builds the buttons and opens the dialogue; hides the apps if hideApps.

updateButtons.desc: Recreates the pins per option, restoring the links.
